fusions.name: Lasso at the Gallop
fusions.desc: Whirls a loop of mesh and hurls it up to 8 tiles, dealing 30 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Rearing Sweep
fusions.desc: You rear and lash a weighted mesh through a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything in it and knocking each enemy 3 tiles back.

fusions.name: Run Out the Line
fusions.desc: Throws a line of mesh ahead and gallops 6 tiles along it; you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Colt on a Tether
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded colt that runs beside you dragging a trailing mesh through enemies within 4 tiles, striking for 5 damage and slowing them by 20% for 2 seconds.
